inspection.recordsLead: These are lab tests, usually using fictional material. They show how one exact package behaved on one disclosed task. They do not prove that a Bot is reliable, useful to a real user, or ready for unattended work.

legend.label: Test designed
legend.meaning: The test is defined, but required source material is still pending.

legend.label: Test prepared
legend.meaning: Input and prompt are ready; the run has not happened.

legend.label: Recorded excerpt
legend.meaning: Part of a run exists, but the full record is incomplete.

legend.label: Prompt-contract runs
legend.meaning: Real outputs are preserved, but the exact downloadable profile was not imported.

legend.label: Failed runtime
legend.meaning: The disclosed run happened, but its output did not pass the stated acceptance checks.

legend.label: Runtime passed once
legend.meaning: One exact-package run passed; independent reproduction and human approval remain separate.

legend.label: Reproduced
legend.meaning: The same package, input, and prompt passed the disclosed checks again.

inspection.disclosure: A passed fixture is test evidence, not real-world proof. Missing and failed records stay visible so a green label cannot hide what was never tested.

evidenceKinds.title: Official Hermes source
evidenceKinds.copy: Official Hermes documentation, release notes, or source code supports the statement. The listing links to that source.

evidenceKinds.title: Tested by Bot Cabinet
evidenceKinds.copy: A Hermes Desktop test record names the Hermes version, computer system, date, exact project version, steps, and result. A later project version requires another test.

evidenceKinds.title: Example plan
evidenceKinds.copy: This is a plan someone can adapt. It does not claim that a downloadable package or working system already exists.

evidenceKinds.title: Publisher description
evidenceKinds.copy: The project publisher described this behavior. Bot Cabinet has not reproduced it in a Hermes Desktop test.

checks.title: Pages and links
checks.copy: Site checks show whether pages and downloads open. Task tests and user review help show whether the instructions are useful and clear.

checks.title: Download contents
checks.copy: Package checks verify the expected files and their contents. They do not test how well a Bot answers a request.

checks.title: Missing results
checks.copy: A missing or overdue public record means the current result is unknown. Private maintenance logs are not shown here.

checks.title: A profile separates Bot data
checks.copy: Each Hermes profile keeps its own settings, memory, and history. The Bot can still use the files and tools that a person gives it permission to use.

checks.title: Anyone can download a public repository
checks.copy: Create a new public package for sharing. Keep credentials, memories, sessions, client material, and private instructions in the live profile.

checks.title: Public source still requires review
checks.copy: Hermes profile packages do not include a built-in signature from the Registry. Record the exact version and review changes before updating.

inspection.caveat: Review access before installing. Tests do not guarantee safety or reliability. Read the requested permissions and try a small task before sharing private information or allowing actions. A test result applies to the named version and task.
